title: MAGICAL 💫
text:
Wow!  What an amazing day. My girlfriend and I booked on to the Blanes tour. 

The hosts went out of their way to make our day that extra bit special even picking us up from Hotel W on the way through! 

With it being our fourth time in Barcelona we wanted to do something different and escape the city.

We have done many wine tours around Europe but this one stands out for being so personable! 

Thanks so much Julia and Klaudia.

All the best
author: adamhM8872SD

title: Exotic
text:
The setting is simply beautiful.
You really have to go out.
Huge specimen of trees and plants from all walks of life.
With views of the magical sea.
But I remove a star because small flat concerning the explanations to know the names of plants or trees that long-term QRs it raises.
And I had anticipated to buy our tickets in advance but in the end it is strictly pointless because we have to queue.
Regarding the parking of the very small garden we ended up on a parking paying 6 € a day which is supposedly 300m.
Snack ice cream is pretty expensive.
